conditions: Closed surface bounding a volume in classical electromagnetism, SI units; outward area elements; total enclosed charge including bound charges. Fields and charge distributions permit the flux law, with no singular point charge on the surface.

evidence: Starting from the differential Maxwell equation div E=rho/epsilon_0, integrate over the volume bounded by S and use the divergence theorem. The volume integral of total charge density is Q_enc. This is the integral form of the physical law, including bound charge where present.
